name: Kharan Mighthammer
label: Quest
description: Kharan Mighthammer: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You have been to the smoldering ruins of Thaurissan? Did you happen to run into a pitiful lout named Kharan Mighthammer? The dwarf that was supposedly watching over my baby girl!
I have had my men turn the Steppes upside down. The only clue they have as to the whereabouts of my daughter is that she may be inside the Depths. For all I know, she could be dead!
Kharan is supposedly being held prisoner there... Find him! I want answers!
